runners_data.name: Ka Mate Du Brivet
runners_data.note: Will dictate terms from the front but question marks over race fitness after limited recent competitive action

runners_data.name: Broomfield Aderra
runners_data.note: Brings the strongest recent form profile and suits tracking the likely steady pace before challenging late

runners_data.name: Willshebe Court
runners_data.note: Hold-up style could be disadvantaged in small field but unknown recent form creates uncertainty about current ability

races.paceDynamic: Ka Mate Du Brivet will control the tempo from the front with no other confirmed pace horses, allowing him to dictate a measured gallop over this extended trip. Broomfield Aderra will likely track in second with Willshebe Court held up at the rear, creating a three-part procession that builds into a tactical finish where positioning and jumping accuracy become crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Win
scenarios.trigger: If Ka Mate Du Brivet jumps cleanly and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The leader uses his tactical advantage to kick clear after the last hurdle when the hold-up horse is still finding his stride. Broomfield Aderra chases hard but cannot reel in the front runner who has controlled every phase.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If Broomfield Aderra travels strongly and Ka Mate Du Brivet's pace becomes pedestrian
scenarios.body: The prominent runner uses superior recent form to wear down the leader in the final furlong after stalking throughout. Ka Mate Du Brivet's lack of recent competitive action tells as Broomfield Aderra's fitness advantage shows.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and Willshebe Court gets the right racing room
scenarios.body: The hold-up runner benefits from a crawling gallop that plays to his patient style, sweeping past tired leaders. Both Ka Mate Du Brivet and Broomfield Aderra pay for their early efforts as the backmarker's fresh finish prevails.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Change Race
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant blunders at crucial hurdles in the home straight
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with mistakes disrupting the natural running order and rhythm. The horse who jumps most fluently late on capitalizes while others lose momentum and positioning through poor jumping.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Ka Mate Du Brivet gets an uncontested lead and whether his jumping rhythm holds under pressure late
Monitor how close Broomfield Aderra tracks the leader and if she travels with obvious enthusiasm turning for home
Check if Willshebe Court gets squeezed for racing room in a small field where positioning options are limited
Observe the early pace judgment as a slow gallop could completely change the tactical dynamics favoring the hold-up horse

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Peking Opera and Vendant press Motazzen from early stages
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and favors those who can sustain their effort. Late runners struggle to make up ground on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Emerge
scenarios.trigger: If steady pace allows closers to get into contention turning for home
scenarios.body: Geordies Betty and Godot use their superior class ratings to power past tiring leaders. The pace collapses in their favor over the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kylenoe Dancer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If recent winner maintains momentum from last victory at this trip
scenarios.body: The improving horse continues upward trajectory and benefits from good going conditions. Form boost proves decisive against higher-rated but less progressive rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Ronnies Reflection leads the prominent contingent alongside Valirann Gold, Daring Plan, Tom Desjy and Engaging Sam, creating a genuine pace scenario with multiple horses wanting to be handy. scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quintet go too hard early and multiple horses crack
scenarios.body: The pace battle between Ronnies Reflection, Valirann Gold, Daring Plan and Tom Desjy becomes unsustainable by the second mile. Kitsilano and Royal Juniper sweep past the weakening leaders in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Prominent Win

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Fail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves too moderate for effective finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The prominent horses settle into a manageable rhythm that doesn't suit the back-markers. Kitsilano and Royal Juniper find insufficient pace collapse to mount their usual late rallies.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kitsilano Class Edge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is perfectly judged to suit the highest-rated runner
